# Jaktra

> AI-native accounts receivable automation platform that automates multi-channel B2B collections with intelligent 5-stage tone escalation, dispute triage, and self-service installment payment plans.

## Core Pages

- [Overview](https://jaktra.site/): Main product landing page featuring accounts receivable automation, platform capabilities, interactive demo, and security architecture.
- [Pricing](https://jaktra.site/pricing): 100% free during Early Access with zero credit card required and no invoice caps.
- [Documentation](https://jaktra.site/docs): Developer documentation, API setup guides, webhook integration specifications, and payment gateway configuration.
- [Privacy Policy](https://jaktra.site/privacy): Detailed information on data isolation, tenant security, AES-256 encryption, and GDPR compliance.
- [Terms of Service](https://jaktra.site/terms): Complete legal terms governing accounts, subscriptions, usage limits, and liability.

## Core Platform Hubs

- [Features Hub](https://jaktra.site/features): The complete autonomous AR execution stack — 5-stage tone escalation, dispute triage, tokenized portals, DLQ deliverability, and predictive risk scoring.
- [Software Buyer's Guide & Compare Hub](https://jaktra.site/compare): Objective comparisons of Jaktra vs HighRadius, Upflow, Chaser, PaidNice, and Kolleno.
- [Industry Solutions Directory](https://jaktra.site/use-cases): B2B DSO benchmarks and tailored dunning workflows across 14 commercial industries.
- [Resources & Knowledge Hub](https://jaktra.site/resources): Research-backed DSO reduction guides, 5-stage tone escalation playbooks, email templates, and working capital ROI calculators.

## Capabilities & Deep Dives

- [5-Stage AI Tone Escalation](https://jaktra.site/features/5-stage-escalation): Dynamic LLaMA 3.1 tone escalation from friendly reminders to Stage 5 legal hold.
- [AI Dispute Triage](https://jaktra.site/features/dispute-triage): NLP sentiment classifier that freezes collection cadences upon debtor disputes.
- [Installment Payment Plans](https://jaktra.site/features/installment-plans): Self-service debtor installment scheduling with automated tracking.
- [Tokenized Debtor Portal](https://jaktra.site/features/zero-login-portal): Zero-login payment links (/i/:token) with instant statement of account review.
- [Email Deliverability Engine](https://jaktra.site/features/email-deliverability): DKIM, SPF, DMARC alignment and automated Dead Letter Queue retry system.
- [Predictive Risk Scoring](https://jaktra.site/features/risk-scoring): Machine learning payment default hazard scoring and adaptive dunning speed.

## Resources & Guides

- [How to Reduce DSO Guide](https://jaktra.site/resources/how-to-reduce-dso): Comprehensive Countback DSO calculation methodology and 5 operational reduction levers.
- [5-Stage AR Tone Escalation Playbook](https://jaktra.site/resources/5-stage-ar-tone-escalation): Complete cadence, timing, and copy templates for accounts receivable dunning.
- [B2B Dunning Email Templates](https://jaktra.site/resources/b2b-dunning-email-templates): Field-tested collection email templates for SaaS, agencies, and enterprise B2B.
- [AR Automation ROI Calculator](https://jaktra.site/resources/ar-automation-roi-calculator): Interactive working capital liberation and bad debt recovery calculator.
- [Invoice Dispute Response Templates](https://jaktra.site/resources/invoice-dispute-response-templates): Free email templates for responding to disputed invoices.
- [AR Query Management Guide](https://jaktra.site/resources/accounts-receivable-query-management): How to manage inbound AR queries and billing emails.
- [Client Questioning Billable Hours](https://jaktra.site/resources/client-questioning-billable-hours): How to respond when clients question invoice hours.
- [Client Disputed Invoice Guide](https://jaktra.site/resources/client-disputed-invoice-what-to-do): Step-by-step guide for when a client disputes an invoice.
- [Managing AR Emails](https://jaktra.site/resources/how-to-manage-accounts-receivable-emails): How to manage shared AR inboxes without chaos.
